name: com.gameframex.unity.fsm
description:
GameFrameX FSM — Unity generic finite state machine package. Manages creation, lifecycle and transitions of typed state machines (states keyed by FsmState<T> type) with per-FSM string-keyed data dictionaries (Variable values, pool-recycled), runtime state management (AddState / RemoveState / Reset) and FixedUpdate polling, in both generic and named FSM overloads. The component stays a thin forwarding entry; the module is reachable directly via GetModule<T>() / GameApp.Fsm. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX FSM — Unity 泛型有限状态机功能包。管理类型化状态机（状态以 FsmState<T> 类型为键）的创建、生命周期与状态转换，支持每个 FSM 的字符串键数据字典（Variable 值，池化回收）、运行时状态管理（AddState / RemoveState / Reset）与 FixedUpdate 轮询，提供泛型与命名 FSM 双重载。组件保留为纯转发薄入口，模块可经 GetModule<T>() / GameApp.Fsm 直达。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
